statement: Let (Y, Θ + M) be a model of the truncated terminal chain. Among the places exceptional over Y with discrepancy less than two, there are only finitely many whose centers have codimension at least three. For each fixed irreducible compact analytic surface V ⊂ Y , there are only finitely many whose center is V . There is a finite set VY of irreducible compact analytic surfaces with the following additional property. If V / ∈ VY , its general point lies in a smooth open where M descends and either no label occurs or exactly one smooth label Sh occurs. There are no positive-weight places centered on V in the first case or when bh = 0. When bh > 0, they are exactly the echoes EV,h,j with j(1 − bh) < 1.
